{"reason":"Add the existing high-confidence gate. It rejects six of the eight shown false arbitrations (confidence 0.44–0.67), directly targeting the 0.714 false-arbitration rate. High-confidence needed cases remain eligible, preserving the current 1.0 recall and avoiding the recall-below-0.8 penalty.","source":"(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))
       (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
